card.name: Items in comma-only lists
card.fires_on: Letters or numbers inside tight comma-separated lists with no spaces, such as footnote letters (c,d), day numbers (1,2,15,16) and section references (5.1,5.2,5.3). It fires on the item just before another comma and item.

card.writes: It promotes odd unrelated tokens and suppresses comma-plus-capital-letter tokens, so it seems to steer away from a comma-letter continuation.
card.plain: It marks a spot inside a tightly packed list like 1,2,15,16 or c,d where the next item is likely a comma and another entry.
